raw_text:
.NET 10/C# 14 **csharparr**: Transmission RPC-compatible put.io/*arr proxy/background transfer manager. ASP.NET Core, Serilog, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience + Polly, System.CommandLine, Tomlyn, xUnit, Moq, FluentAssertions. Prefer simplicity; avoid over-engineering and unrequested features.

Structure: `Commands/`, `Configuration/`, `Download/`, `Http/`, `Services/`, `Program.cs`; tests in `tests/Csharparr.Tests/`.

PascalCase public symbols; camelCase locals/parameters; `_camelCase` private fields; `I` interfaces; file-scoped namespaces; records for DTOs/immutable data; pattern matching; nullable enabled; top-level `Program.cs`; `[]` empty collections; `Lock`, not `object`; primary constructors when appropriate; raw strings for multiline/special strings. Use `var` when obvious, explicit types for clarity, expression bodies, `?.`, `??`, `??=`. Keep methods focused and under ~50 lines when possible.

All I/O-bound operations must be async. Always pass `CancellationToken` through the call chain; use `cancellationToken = default` for optional parameters; suffix async methods `Async`. Catch `OperationCanceledException` separately; log cancellation at Debug, not Error.

Use `BackgroundService`, bounded `Channel<T>`, tracked/periodically cleaned tasks. Use typed clients (`AddHttpClient<IPutioClient, PutioClient>`), named clients (`AddHttpClient("ArrClient")`), `IHttpClientFactory`, per-operation timeouts, exponential retry with jitter and circuit breaker via `Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience` (not deprecated `Polly.Extensions.Http`). Retry network errors, timeouts, and HTTP 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504. Log `BrokenCircuitException` at Debug; socket errors as Warning without full stack trace.

Register configuration singleton and services with interfaces; use factories; test DI resolution and concurrent resolution. Use exceptions for exceptional cases and domain exceptions; include HTTP response body truncated to 500 chars; continue when one service fails.

Use structured logging with message templates, not string interpolation. Levels: Debug operational, Information important events, Warning recovered/expected failures, Error attention, Fatal terminating. Override `Microsoft.Hosting.Lifetime: Information`. Use thread-safe collections and periodically clean resources.

Test happy/error paths with mocked HTTP/external dependencies, FluentAssertions, and DI resolution using `WebApplicationFactory<Program>`. Use Tomlyn; validate startup with all errors. Config: `username`, `password`, `instance_name` (3-10 alphanumeric), `instance_folder_id`, `download_directory`, `putio.api_key`; at least one arr service.

Implement `[Route("/transmission/rpc")]`, preserve JSON names (`PropertyNamingPolicy = null`), `/health` returning 200. Use multi-stage Dockerfile, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK; support linux-x64, linux-arm64, osx-x64, osx-arm64.

Don't add features or refactor beyond what's requested
Don't add comments, docstrings, or type annotations to unchanged code
Don't create helpers or abstractions for one-time operations
Don't add error handling for scenarios that can't happen
Don't use `Polly.Extensions.Http` (deprecated)—use `Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience`
Don't log at Error level for expected conditions (cancellation, circuit breaker)
Don't use string interpolation in log messages
Don't register concrete types when interfaces exist
